{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in the relevant columns: customer_segment and converted
print("Missing values in 'customer_segment':")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].isnull().sum())

print("\nMissing values in 'converted':")
print(sales_df['converted'].isnull().sum())

# Also confirm no missing values in 'customer_segment' and 'converted' for the loyal subset
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print("\nMissing values in 'converted' among LOYAL customers:")
print(loyal_customers['converted'].isnull().sum())"}
